question: Should every assessment use deeper research?
workload: Illustrative Condere research assessments with a matched acceptance rule.

alternatives.name: Selective research
alternatives.cost: USD 42 for ten illustrative attempts including review. Six accepted gives USD 7 per accepted outcome.
alternatives.quality: Reviewer accepts the sourced recommendation without rework.

alternatives.name: Research every request
alternatives.cost: USD 56 for ten illustrative attempts. Candidate acceptance remains unknown.
alternatives.quality: Apply the same reviewer rule and include effort spent correcting the result.

evidence.finding: The baseline includes six accepted assessments. All counts are illustrative.
Delivery and review costs are modeled for both options.

recommendation: Keep selective research as the comparison baseline. The proposed alternative needs eight accepted outcomes per ten attempts to match its modeled unit cost.
reversal_condition: Reassess after measuring comparable founder acceptance, net charges, and review effort.
missing: Founder acceptance on the candidate cohort, effective net charges, and measured review time.
